answer_1.quote: In AgentSense, we situate LLM-driven agents in the constructed scenarios, where each participant has social goals and may also safeguard some private information. The agents primarily interact through multiturn conversations...
answer_1.outputs: Multi-turn conversational dialogues in interactive social scenarios

answer_2.quote: We then calculate the average accuracy (Acc) of the current agent on these questions to determine the agent's score in information reasoning. We also compute the standard deviation of goal/information metrics across scenarios to obtain the PSI index.

answer_3.quote: We select GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72b, and Llama-3-70b from different model families as our judge models, referred to as Judge-GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, and Llama-3 hereafter.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human validation on the generated templates from the automatic pipeline to ensure the quality of our benchmark. We randomly sample 100 simulated scenarios... and manually verify whether the communication history shows that the goals were achieved.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to answer yes/no whether each agent achieved its social goals based on the conversation history.
